label: The .sby file
subgoals: Set the mode and depth in the options section
Write read -formal and prep -top in the script section
List the sources in the files section and engines in the engines section

label: Modes and engines
subgoals: Pick bmc, prove, cover or live for the question asked
Pick smtbmc with a solver, abc pdr or abc bmc3 as the algorithm
List several engines to run them as a portfolio

label: Reading the results
subgoals: Read PASS in bmc mode as bounded evidence only
Separate base-case failures from induction-step failures
Use witness traces and add assumptions for illegal environment behavior
